name: Gruha Lakshmi Direct Bank Transfer (₹2,000/Month)
ministry: Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Karnataka
benefitSummary: ₹2,000 every month (₹24,000/year) transferred directly into the bank account of the woman head of the family, plus free non-AC bus travel across the state under Shakti.
statutoryRule: Govt Order WCD 2023: Payable to ONE woman head listed on Ration Card. Excluded if woman or husband pays Income Tax or files GST returns.
commonRejectionTrap: Ration card e-KYC incomplete or bank account NPCI Aadhaar DBT mapper inactive.
documents: Ration Card (Antyodaya / BPL / APL showing Woman Head)
physicalCounter: GramaOne / KarnatakaOne / Bapuji Seva Kendra (₹0 Official Fee)
cscSteps: Open sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Click Gruha Lakshmi → Enter Ration Card No. → Verify Aadhaar OTP → Print Ack Slip.

name: Gruha Jyothi Free 200 Units Electricity Subsidy
ministry: Energy Department (BESCOM / MESCOM / HESCOM / GESCOM / CESC)
benefitType: Zero Electricity Bill up to 200 Units
benefitSummary: 100% free household electricity up to 200 units per month (saves ~₹14,400/year in cash for a typical family).
statutoryRule: Applicable to 1 domestic meter per household/Aadhaar (both owners and tenants are legally eligible).
commonRejectionTrap: Account ID / RR Number not linked with tenant/owner Aadhaar on Seva Sindhu.
documents: Rental Agreement or Voter ID (if tenant)
physicalCounter: Any ESCOM Office, GramaOne, KarnatakaOne, or Cyber-Café
cscSteps: Open sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Click Gruha Jyothi → Select ESCOM Name → Enter Account ID → Link Aadhaar via OTP.

name: Anna Bhagya Cash DBT + PMGKAY Free Ration
ministry: Dept of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs
benefitSummary: 5 kg free foodgrains per member under PMGKAY + ₹170/month per member direct bank cash transfer (approx ₹10,200/yr for a family).
statutoryRule: Mandatory monthly biometric thumb verification at Fair Price Shop (Ration Depot) + active BPL/Antyodaya card.
commonRejectionTrap: Head of family Aadhaar not linked with Food & Civil Supplies DBT server.
documents: Aadhaar Cards of All Family Members
physicalCounter: Fair Price Shop (Ration Depot) / Food Inspector Office / GramaOne
cscSteps: Check DBT status at ahara.kar.nic.in → E-Services → E-Status → DBT Transfer Status → Enter Ration Card Number.

name: National Scholarship Portal (Central Post-Matric Scholarship)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Minority Affairs
benefitSummary: ₹22,000/year tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance credited straight to student's bank account.
statutoryRule: NSP OTR Guidelines: Student can hold only ONE Central Sector scholarship at a time. Family income ≤ ₹2.5L.
commonRejectionTrap: Aadhaar not seeded with NPCI mapper or Face-Auth OTR incomplete on NSP App.
physicalCounter: College Scholarship Nodal Desk / Any CSC / Cyber-Café
cscSteps: Login to scholarships.gov.in → Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) → Face Auth via NSP App → Select Post-Matric Scheme → Upload RD Certificate.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College Students
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefitSummary: ₹12,000/year (UG) to ₹20,000/year (PG) direct bank transfer for college students from families earning under ₹4.5L.
statutoryRule: Mutually exclusive with other Central Scholarships under NSP; Hakku automatically picks the higher-paying scholarship.
commonRejectionTrap: Class 12 roll number verification pending on NSP portal.
physicalCounter: College Nodal Officer / CSC / Cyber-Café
cscSteps: scholarships.gov.in → Student Login → Dept of Higher Education → PM-USP Central Sector Scheme.

name: State SSP & Vidyasiri Food/Hostel Stipend (₹15,000/Yr)
ministry: Backward Classes / Social Welfare Dept, Govt of Karnataka
benefitSummary: ₹1,500/month for 10 months (₹15,000/yr) for day-scholar/PG students + government college fee reimbursement.
statutoryRule: Karnataka Sakala Act SLA: 21 Working Days. Can be legally stacked with non-conflicting fee concessions.
commonRejectionTrap: Name spelling mismatch between SSLC marksheet and Aadhaar Card.
physicalCounter: GramaOne / Cyber-Café + College SSP Nodal Officer
cscSteps: ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in → Create SSP Account → Enter RD Number from Nadakacheri → e-Attestation by College Officer.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (₹50,000/Yr)
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
benefitSummary: ₹50,000 per annum every year of study for female students pursuing Diploma or Degree in technical/engineering/management courses.
statutoryRule: Up to 2 girl children per family with annual family income below ₹8,00,000 are eligible.
commonRejectionTrap: Applying under general NSP instead of AICTE-Pragati tab on scholarships.gov.in.
physicalCounter: College AICTE Nodal Officer / scholarships.gov.in
cscSteps: scholarships.gov.in → AICTE Schemes Tab → Select Pragati Scholarship for Girls → Upload Bonafide & Income Certificate.

name: Yuva Nidhi Graduate & Diploma Allowance (₹3,000/Month)
ministry: Dept of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship & Livelihood
benefitSummary: ₹3,000/month (₹36,000/year) for unemployed Degree graduates and ₹1,500/month for Diploma holders for up to 2 years until employed.
statutoryRule: Candidate must submit monthly self-declaration on Seva Sindhu confirming they are not in full-time PF-paying employment or higher studies.
commonRejectionTrap: Forgetting to submit the monthly 1-click self-declaration between the 1st and 25th of each month.
physicalCounter: GramaOne / KarnatakaOne / District Employment Exchange
cscSteps: sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Yuva Nidhi Scheme → Verify University Registration No. → Submit Monthly Self-Declaration.

name: PM Vishwakarma Grant (₹15,000 Toolkit + ₹500/Day Stipend)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefitType: Free Toolkit Grant + Training Cash + 5% Loan
benefitSummary: ₹15,000 free e-voucher for modern tools + ₹500/day training stipend (~₹3,500) + collateral-free ₹1L–₹3L enterprise loan at just 5% interest.
statutoryRule: Open to 18 traditional/self-employed trades (tailors, carpenters, masons, mechanics, barbers, goldsmiths, potters, etc.). One member per family.
commonRejectionTrap: Applying directly online without CSC biometric authentication (PM Vishwakarma requires CSC biometric login).
physicalCounter: MUST Visit Nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) — Free Registration
cscSteps: Visit CSC → Operator logs into pmvishwakarma.gov.in → Biometric Auth → Select Trade (e.g. Tailor/Carpenter/Mason) → Gram Panchayat Verification.

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (₹6,000/Year Cash)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefitSummary: ₹6,000/year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 transferred directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
statutoryRule: PM-KISAN Para 4: Income Tax payers and regular Govt employees are statutorily excluded.
commonRejectionTrap: e-KYC incomplete or Land Seeding marked 'NO' in Revenue/Bhoomi records.
physicalCounter: Raitha Samparka Kendra / CSC / GramaOne
cscSteps: pmkisan.gov.in → Farmers Corner → Complete OTP/Biometric e-KYC → Verify Land Seeding = YES & Aadhaar Bank Seeding = YES.

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Pump 60% Govt Subsidy
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefitSummary: Up to 60% government grant on solar irrigation pumps (saves ~₹45,000/yr in diesel and electricity expenses).
statutoryRule: MNRE PM-KUSUM Guidelines: 30% Central + 30% State subsidy; farmer pays only 10% upfront (30% bank loan).
commonRejectionTrap: Applying through fake private websites instead of official state nodal portal (KREDL / pmkusum.mnre.gov.in).
physicalCounter: State Renewable Energy Nodal Office (KREDL) / Raitha Samparka Kendra
cscSteps: Apply ONLY via pmkusum.mnre.gov.in or State Nodal Portal when district quota opens.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (85% Govt-Paid Crop Shield)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefitSummary: Government pays ~85% of premium; farmer pays only 1.5%–2% for full financial payout on drought, flood, or pest loss.
statutoryRule: Localised calamity/hailstorm loss must be reported within 72 hours on Crop Insurance App or 14447 helpline.
commonRejectionTrap: Crop name mismatch between RTC Pahani crop survey and bank portal entry.
physicalCounter: Raitha Samparka Kendra / Rural Bank Branch / CSC
cscSteps: pmfby.gov.in → Farmer Application → Select Season (Kharif/Rabi) → Enter Survey Number → Get Policy Receipt.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) 4% Interest Subvention Grant
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture / RBI
benefitSummary: Working capital up to ₹3 Lakh at just 4% effective interest (Govt pays 3% interest subvention bonus on timely repayment, saving ~₹15,000/yr).
statutoryRule: RBI Circular: Banks must waive processing/inspection charges for KCC limits up to ₹3 Lakh.
commonRejectionTrap: Missing prompt repayment window, which forfeits the 3% government interest subsidy.
physicalCounter: Nearest Nationalised / Rural / Cooperative Bank Branch
cscSteps: Download KCC 1-page form from pmkisan.gov.in → Submit at Bank Branch where PM-KISAN is credited.

name: NSAP Old Age Pension + Sandhya Suraksha (₹14,400/Yr)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / Directorate of Social Security
benefitSummary: ₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) lifetime monthly pension credited straight to bank or post office account for seniors 60+.
statutoryRule: Social Security Pension Rules: A citizen can draw only ONE social security pension (Old Age OR Widow) at a time.
commonRejectionTrap: Annual Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) biometric e-KYC not renewed.
physicalCounter: Nadakacheri / GramaOne / Taluk Office
cscSteps: sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in / Nadakacheri → Sandhya Suraksha / IGNOAPS → Village Accountant Field Verification within 21 Sakala days.

name: Indira Gandhi Destitute Widow Pension (₹14,400/Yr)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / State Social Security Dept
benefitSummary: ₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) direct monthly pension for widows from low-income households.
statutoryRule: Mutually exclusive with Old-Age Pension under NSAP rules; Hakku prevents duplicate pension filing that triggers recovery notices.
commonRejectionTrap: Husband's Death Certificate registration number not verified on e-JanMa portal.
physicalCounter: Nadakacheri / GramaOne / Seva Sindhu Counter
cscSteps: Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu → Destitute Widow Pension → Attach Death Certificate & Ration Card.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (Free LPG + ₹300/Cylinder Cashback)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefitSummary: Free LPG connection (worth ₹1,600) + ₹300 per cylinder bank subsidy for up to 12 refills/year (₹3,600/yr).
statutoryRule: Issued in the name of an adult woman of a BPL household without an existing LPG connection.
commonRejectionTrap: Aadhaar e-KYC not completed with the LPG gas agency (Indane/HP/Bharatgas).
physicalCounter: Nearest Indane / Bharatgas / HP Gas Agency or CSC
cscSteps: pmuy.gov.in → Apply for New Ujjwala 2.0 Connection → Select Distributor → Complete Biometric e-KYC.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (₹5,000–₹6,000 Maternity Cash)
ministry: Ministry of Women & Child Development
benefitSummary: ₹5,000 cash transfer for first child and ₹6,000 for second girl child under PMMVY 2.0 directly to mother's bank account.
statutoryRule: Must have MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card registered at local Anganwadi / Primary Health Centre.
commonRejectionTrap: Delay in registering pregnancy at Anganwadi beyond 150 days.
physicalCounter: Local Anganwadi Centre / Primary Health Centre (PHC) / GramaOne
cscSteps: pmmvy.wcd.gov.in → Citizen Login → Fill Form 1-A using MCP Card Date → Anganwadi Supervisor Approval.

name: e-Shram + PM-SYM Unorganized Worker Shield (₹36,000/Yr Pension)
ministry: Ministry of Labour & Employment
benefitSummary: Free ₹2,00,000 PMSBY Accident Cover via e-Shram + Central Govt matches 100% of your contribution toward a guaranteed ₹3,000/month pension after age 60.
statutoryRule: Open to informal workers, street vendors, domestic workers, drivers, agricultural laborers, and homemakers aged 18–40 (non-EPFO/non-taxpayer).
commonRejectionTrap: Mobile number not linked to Aadhaar for instant UAN e-Shram card generation.
physicalCounter: Any CSC Centre or Self-Registration on eshram.gov.in
cscSteps: Open eshram.gov.in → Register on e-Shram → Enter Aadhaar OTP → Download 12-Digit UAN Card Instantly.

name: PM Awas Yojana Housing Grant (₹1,20,000–₹2,50,000 Total)
ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / Rural Development
benefitSummary: ₹1,20,000 (Rural PMAY-G) to ₹2,50,000 (Urban PMAY-U 2.0) direct grant in 3–4 geo-tagged installments to build a pucca house (amortized ~₹30,000/yr value).
statutoryRule: Beneficiary family must not own an existing pucca house anywhere in India; female ownership or joint ownership is mandatory.
commonRejectionTrap: Geo-tagging photo not uploaded via AwaasApp before laying foundation.
physicalCounter: Gram Panchayat (PMAY-G) / Municipal Corporation Office (PMAY-U)
cscSteps: pmaymis.gov.in / pmayg.nic.in → Citizen Assessment → Apply under Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC).

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY + 70+ Senior Vay Vandana (₹5 Lakh Cover)
ministry: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health
benefitSummary: ₹5,00,000/year free cashless treatment at 29,000+ public & private hospitals (plus universal ₹5L cover for all seniors aged 70+ regardless of income).
statutoryRule: NHA 2024 Amendment: All senior citizens aged 70+ qualify irrespective of income; BPL/priority families covered at all ages.
commonRejectionTrap: Waiting until a medical emergency instead of pre-downloading the Ayushman Golden Card.
physicalCounter: Any Hospital Ayushman Mitra Desk / GramaOne / Ayushman Mobile App
cscSteps: beneficiary.nha.gov.in → Login with Mobile → Search by Ration Card or 70+ Senior Enrollment → e-KYC → Download Ayushman Card.
